patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Replaces the old Holo-blue accent with your wallpaper colours (Android 12+) or a colour you choose, tints the dark and light backgrounds to match, and rounds dialogs, sheets, cards and progress bars the way Material 3 does. The in-app Light, Dark and Black theme choice keeps working.

options.title: Custom accent colour
options.description: Leave empty to follow your wallpaper colours (Material You, Android 12+). Or enter a hex colour such as #8AB4F8 to use that accent on every Android version.

options.title: Tint backgrounds
options.description: Gives the Dark and Light themes the softly tinted Material You surfaces (Android 12+). The Black theme stays pure black for AMOLED screens.

options.title: Rounded shapes
options.description: Rounds dialogs (28dp), bottom sheets, cards and buttons, and makes progress bars thicker with pill-shaped ends.

patches.name: Modern font
patches.description: Uses the rounded geometric Outfit font across the classic SABP screens (lists, settings, toolbars), keeping each label's weight. eppy always uses it.

patches.name: eppy
patches.description: eppy: a new Material 3 player for SABP. A Home screen with Continue Listening and shelves, a cover-grid Library, and Now Playing with a circular play button, Add/Remove bookmark, and a drag-up sheet: native Chapters, Read along (pair an EPUB/PDF and follow the narration), Bookmarks, Details and Up next. Six styles based on reference designs, a floating mini-player, adaptive navigation, accessibility and keyboard support. Playback stays on SABP's own engine. Best used with Hooman's SABP patch.

options.title: Use eppy as the player
options.description: Default player interface. On: the app icon, notification, widgets, library and voice search all open eppy. Off: they open the classic SABP player. Either way you can switch later in eppy Settings → Player interface (with Classic chosen, long-press the app icon → eppy).

options.title: Style
options.description: The look the app starts with, based on the reference designs. Every style can also be switched in eppy Settings → Style without re-patching.

options.title: Read-along speech matching
options.description: Lets Read along match the narration to your EPUB/PDF with Android's on-device speech recogniser (Android 13+). Adds the microphone permission, which Android's speech service requires even though only the audiobook's own audio is fed to it. You are asked before it's used. Turn off to keep read-along to chapter alignment and manual sync only (no microphone permission).

options.title: Default theme
options.description: Light, dark, black or follow the system. Can be changed later in eppy Settings.

options.title: Default accent
options.description: Where the accent colour comes from. "Book cover" picks a readable colour from the playing book's artwork. Can be changed later in eppy Settings.

options.title: Custom accent colour
options.description: Hex colour used when the accent is "Custom colour", and on Android 11.
